column1: [BUG-001] Import returns HTTP 500 when a batch contains a return after a sale
column9: Build 0.1.0-rc1 (tag v0.1.0-rc1), Python 3.13, FastAPI 0.143, SQLModel 0.0.48, Ubuntu 24.04, SQLite and PostgreSQL 16
column10:
Bug file in the repo: bugs/BUG-001.md
Requirement: REQ-IMP-01
Found by: TC-IMP-001, TC-IMP-006, full-volume load (import mode)
Severity: S1 Critical

*Steps to reproduce*
# Create seller {{S00001}} in store {{T1000}}.
# {{POST /imports/transactions}} with a SALE {{I-1}} of 300.00 and a RETURN {{I-2}} of 100.00 that references {{I-1}}.

*Expected result*
201 with {{{"imported": 2, "sales": 1, "returns": 1, "credits": 2}}}.

*Actual result*
500 Internal Server Error with a plain-text body. Server log: {{AttributeError: 'list' object has no attribute 'original_transaction_id'}} in {{app/service.py}}, {{build_transaction}}.

*Impact*
Any realistic batch fails, because returns are about 5.5% of the rows. The full dataset could not be loaded through the import endpoint, which blocked the parallel run. Workaround used for rc1: load with one {{POST /transactions}} per row (25,259 calls).

column1: [BUG-002] Gate is evaluated on the rounded attainment, so 49.995% to 49.99999% qualifies
column9: Build 0.1.0-rc1 (tag v0.1.0-rc1), Python 3.13, FastAPI 0.143, SQLModel 0.0.48, Ubuntu 24.04
column10:
Bug file in the repo: bugs/BUG-002.md
Requirement: REQ-CAL-03
Found by: TC-CAL-001, TC-CAL-002, TC-REC-001 (seller S19002)
Severity: S2 Major

*Steps to reproduce*
# Create seller {{S00001}} and a 2026-10 quota of 100,000.00.
# Post a SALE of 49,995.00 dated 2026-10-01.
# {{GET /periods/2026-10/sellers/S00001/statement}}.

*Expected result*
{{attainment_pct}} "50.00" (display only), {{qualified}} false, {{payout}} "0.00". REQ-CAL-03 evaluates the gate on the exact value (49.995%).

*Actual result*
{{qualified}} true and {{payout}} "499.95". The same happens with 49,999.99, which pays 500.00.

*Impact*
Any seller between 49.995% and 50% is paid as if they passed the gate. In the dataset: 1 statement (boundary seller S19002) overpaid by 499.95.

column1: [BUG-003] Payout half-cent ties round to even instead of half-up
column9: Build 0.1.0-rc1 (tag v0.1.0-rc1), Python 3.13, FastAPI 0.143, SQLModel 0.0.48, Ubuntu 24.04
column10:
Bug file in the repo: bugs/BUG-003.md
Requirement: REQ-CAL-06
Found by: TC-CAL-010, TC-REC-001
Severity: S2 Major

*Steps to reproduce*
# Create seller {{S00001}} and a 2026-10 quota of 10,000.00.
# Post SALES totalling 5,000.50.
# Get the statement.

*Expected result*
{{payout}} "50.01" (50.005 rounds half-up).

*Actual result*
{{payout}} "50.00".

*Impact*
One cent under on every payout whose exact value ends in 5 at the third decimal. In the dataset: 4 payouts underpaid by 0.01. Three of them belong to ordinary sellers from the random data, not to the crafted boundary seller.

column1: [BUG-004] Returns made exactly 30 days after the sale are not clawed back
column9: Build 0.1.0-rc1 (tag v0.1.0-rc1), Python 3.13, FastAPI 0.143, SQLModel 0.0.48, Ubuntu 24.04
column10:
Bug file in the repo: bugs/BUG-004.md
Requirement: REQ-RET-04
Found by: TC-RET-002, TC-REC-001
Severity: S2 Major

*Steps to reproduce*
# Create sellers {{S00001}} and {{S00002}} in {{T1000}}.
# Post a SALE of 10,000.00 split 70/30 dated 2026-10-05.
# Post a RETURN of 1,000.00 for that sale dated 2026-11-04 (30 days later).

*Expected result*
Credit lines -700.00 for S00001 and -300.00 for S00002 (the window is 30 days or less).

*Actual result*
201 with no credit lines, as if the return were outside the window.

*Impact*
The largest money defect of rc1. In the dataset: 30 returns on day 30, 31 statements with a wrong credited amount and 26 payouts overpaid, 6,066.83 MXN in total.

column1: [BUG-005] Odd-cent clawback on a split return moves one cent between the sellers
column9: Build 0.1.0-rc1 (tag v0.1.0-rc1), Python 3.13, FastAPI 0.143, SQLModel 0.0.48, Ubuntu 24.04
column10:
Bug file in the repo: bugs/BUG-005.md
Requirement: REQ-RET-04
Found by: TC-RET-004, TC-REC-001
Severity: S2 Major

*Steps to reproduce*
# Post a SALE of 10,000.00 split 70/30 (S00001, S00002).
# Post a RETURN of 100.01 for it inside the window.

*Expected result*
-70.01 for S00001 and -30.00 for S00002 (magnitudes use the sale rule, then are negated).

*Actual result*
-70.00 for S00001 and -30.01 for S00002.

*Impact*
The return still nets to -100.01, but each seller's statement is off by one cent per return. In the dataset: 171 seller statements with a wrong credited amount (162 of them only because of this defect, off by 0.01 to 0.05), and 2 payouts changed by 0.01.

column1: [BUG-006] Displayed attainment and band commissions use banker's rounding on ties
column9: Build 0.1.0-rc1 (tag v0.1.0-rc1), Python 3.13, FastAPI 0.143, SQLModel 0.0.48, Ubuntu 24.04

Bug file in the repo: bugs/BUG-006.md
Requirement: REQ-CAL-06, REQ-STM-03
Found by: TC-CAL-010, TC-CAL-014, TC-CAL-015
Severity: S3 Minor

*Steps to reproduce*
# Quota 100,000.00, credited 12,345.00: get the statement (attainment 12.345%).
# Quota 10,000.00, credited 5,000.50: get the statement (attainment 50.005%, band A commission 50.005).

*Expected result*
{{attainment_pct}} "12.35" and "50.01". Band A {{commission}} "50.01".

*Actual result*
"12.34", "50.00" and "50.00".

*Impact*
Display only: the statement a seller reads disagrees with the plan's rounding rule on ties. Tracked apart from BUG-003 because it does not change the money, although the cause is the same.

Bug file in the repo: bugs/BUG-007.md
Requirement: REQ-API-01
Found by: TC-API-006, Newman collection-level envelope check
Severity: S3 Minor

*Steps to reproduce*
# {{GET /nope}}.
# {{DELETE /health}}.

*Expected result*
404 and 405 with {{{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}}}.

*Actual result*
{{{"detail": "Not Found"}}} and {{{"detail": "Method Not Allowed"}}}. Unhandled exceptions return a plain-text {{Internal Server Error}} body, which Newman's envelope check also flagged.

*Impact*
Clients that parse {{error.code}} break on these responses.

column1: [BUG-008] On PostgreSQL every sale fails with HTTP 500 (credit rows inserted before their transaction)
column9: Build 0.1.0-rc1 (tag v0.1.0-rc1), Python 3.13, FastAPI 0.143, SQLModel 0.0.48, Ubuntu 24.04, PostgreSQL 16 only (passes on SQLite)
column10:
Bug file in the repo: bugs/BUG-008.md
Requirement: REQ-CRD-02 (all transaction flows)
Found by: 52 of 107 functional results on PostgreSQL, Newman run on PostgreSQL
Severity: S1 Critical

*Steps to reproduce*
# Run the API with {{DATABASE_URL=postgresql+psycopg://...}}.
# Create seller {{S00001}}.
# Post any SALE with credits.

*Expected result*
201 with the credit lines.

*Actual result*
500. Log: {{psycopg.errors.ForeignKeyViolation: insert or update on table "credit" violates foreign key constraint "credit_transaction_id_fkey"}}.

*Impact*
The production database rejects every sale and return. The functional suite passed on SQLite because SQLite does not enforce foreign keys unless {{PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON}} is set, so the defect was invisible there.
